purpose: Research rubric for generic Phase 2B quality uplift; not a customer-facing claim generator.

research_metrics.bespoke_feel: Company Truth to form specificity, not a template or palette score.
research_metrics.form_causality: Count of explicit truth/state/goal to form to customer-effect links.
research_metrics.premium_finish: Craft, hierarchy and browser/mobile integrity together.
research_metrics.conversion_confidence: Hesitation, resolved uncertainty, reason to act and next step are all explicit.
research_metrics.evidence_ceiling: Facts unavailable without Hearing; never fill with invented claims.
research_metrics.creative_ceiling: Improvements still possible through form, rhythm, type and composition alone.

sales_sample_gate.decision: PASS only when every hard check is true; otherwise HOLD.

holdout_policy: Hold-out output is evaluated after generic rules are frozen and is excluded from rule selection.
manual_intervention: Generated HTML, CSS and copy are never edited; fixes occur in generic Engine layers and regenerate outputs.
